environment: python3 branches.py on macOS, node test runner, testkit property seeded generator, fake gh via monkeypatch in-process and stub-server shim for CLI runs

cases.title: Format resolves from flag, config or default (property)
cases.given: 1000 random repos: config absent or holding strings, empty, null, number, bad formats; flag absent or random
cases.then: Flag beats config beats default; given is true for flag or config; a format git or the placeholder rules refuse gives exit 2 with a one-object error
cases.expected: Flag beats config beats default; given is true for flag or config; a format git or the placeholder rules refuse gives exit 2 with a one-object error
cases.actual: 1000 runs, 0 violations against the reference model (placeholder count, braces, Python whitespace set, git check-ref-format)

evidence.title: format resolution
evidence.inline: property: format resolution against reference model; seed=424242 runs=1000 violations=0

cases.title: Spec examples and corner formats
cases.given: Broken config JSON with --format; config only; neither; 12 invalid and 4 valid corner formats (empty, {name}{name}, spaces, a..b, .lock, leading slash, NBSP, ideographic space, emoji, accents)
cases.then: Flag wins over a broken config; given false and sdlc/{name} for neither; invalid formats exit 2 with ok false and error
cases.expected: Flag wins over a broken config; given false and sdlc/{name} for neither; invalid formats exit 2 with ok false and error

cases.title: build_samples follows the mode (property)
cases.given: 1000 random valid formats, modes pr, stack, mr, direct and an unknown mode, working branch values
cases.when: build_samples is called through the module
cases.then: pr: slice, state, e2e; stack: run, milestone, slice; mr adds working last only when a name is given; other modes none; names follow the format and the lower transform
cases.expected: pr: slice, state, e2e; stack: run, milestone, slice; mr adds working last only when a name is given; other modes none; names follow the format and the lower transform
cases.actual: 1000 runs, 0 violations; every sample has exactly kind and name; every state name holds 14 digits

evidence.title: build_samples
evidence.inline: property: build_samples against reference model; seed=424243 runs=1000 violations=0

cases.title: Preflight samples per mode with prefix and lowercase formats
cases.given: 4 formats (sdlc/{name}, feature/{name:lower}, pre-{name}, {name}) in 4 modes; --branch in direct and pr
cases.then: Sample kinds and names equal the reference; state timestamp is current UTC; --branch adds nothing in pr and direct
cases.expected: Sample kinds and names equal the reference; state timestamp is current UTC; --branch adds nothing in pr and direct

cases.title: Verdict rows, first failing rule, exit code, per-sample rules (property)
cases.given: 1000 cases: github repo, random formats, modes, working branches (valid and invalid refs), per-sample rule sets of 4 operators with negate, bad regexes, unknown kinds, noise objects, and gh errors
cases.when: main() runs with a fake gh
cases.then: Each row result and rule equal the model; the rule is the label of the first failing rule; ok false exactly when a row fails; exit 1 then, else 0; gh call list equals the model; output holds all required keys; row keys are exactly kind, name, result, rule
cases.expected: Each row result and rule equal the model; the rule is the label of the first failing rule; ok false exactly when a row fails; exit 1 then, else 0; gh call list equals the model; output holds all required keys; row keys are exactly kind, name, result, rule
cases.actual: 1000 runs, 0 violations; 396 cases had a failing row and 86 had an unevaluated row

evidence.title: verdict model
evidence.inline: property: verdict model; seed=424244 runs=1000 violations=0 casesWithFail=396 casesWithUnevaluated=86 notesSeen=267

cases.title: Notes merge without duplicates in first-seen order
cases.given: Same bad regex on three samples; two bad rules in mixed order; unknown kind; gh error on the second sample
cases.when: preflight runs with a fake gh
cases.then: One cannot evaluate note for the same rule; order is first seen; a rules unknown note stands alone and all samples are unchecked
cases.expected: One cannot evaluate note for the same rule; order is first seen; a rules unknown note stands alone and all samples are unchecked
cases.actual: notes: one note for the repeated rule; bad-two before bad-one; one note for the unknown kind; one rules unknown note. The property test also checks no duplicate notes in 1000 cases

cases.title: Each sample is judged against its own rules
cases.given: gh returns different rules per sample; overlapping rules A, B, C on all samples; a duplicate-name pair (white-box probe)
cases.then: A rule for one sample fails only that sample; overlapping rules give the first failing label per sample; the union rules list is deduplicated; a duplicate name shares one gh call and keeps two rows
cases.expected: A rule for one sample fails only that sample; overlapping rules give the first failing label per sample; the union rules list is deduplicated; a duplicate name shares one gh call and keeps two rows
cases.actual: as expected; replacing by_sample with the union rules makes this test and the property fail

evidence.title: per-sample rules
evidence.inline: result pass; mutation check: union rules -> VS-9 test fails and property gives 357 violations

cases.title: Consumer view: CLI process with a gh shim
cases.given: Scratch git repo with forge github, gh shim, cwd outside the repo
cases.when: python3 branches.py preflight runs for pr, stack, bogus mode, mr with a..b
cases.then: Exit 1 with one JSON line and empty stderr when a sample fails; exit 0 when all pass; exit 2 with ok false for a bad mode; a..b fails with git check-ref-format; repo tree unchanged
cases.expected: Exit 1 with one JSON line and empty stderr when a sample fails; exit 0 when all pass; exit 2 with ok false for a bad mode; a..b fails with git check-ref-format; repo tree unchanged

cases.title: Hostile --branch values keep the output shape
cases.given: 17 hostile names: option-like, empty, spaces, unicode, 5000 characters, tab, bidi mark, @{-1}, @, double slash, .lock, backslash
cases.then: Exit is 0, 1 or 2; non-error output holds every required key; the working sample name equals the input
cases.expected: Exit is 0, 1 or 2; non-error output holds every required key; the working sample name equals the input

seeds.title: --branch with an empty value is ignored in mr mode
seeds.detail: `--mode mr --branch ""` gives no working sample and exit 0, because build_samples tests the value for truth. The spec says only that --branch CURRENT adds the sample. An empty value cannot be a branch, so this is likely right, but no requirement states it.

seeds.title: No real mode can give two samples with one name
seeds.detail: Duplicate names reach verdict only through a patched build_samples. The shared-entry design in the plan is dead code for now. The verifier covered it with a white-box probe.

seeds.title: Preflight output carries command, args and given beyond the spec keys
seeds.detail: The plan keeps them for earlier tests. The spec lists eight keys. A strict consumer that compares key sets sees three extra keys.
